summary_en: 650,000 shares (3.27% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-10 at ¥993/share (closing price 2026-08-07), maximum ¥715M outlay. Execution at 08:45 JST Tokyo Stock Exchange. Results to be announced same day post-trade.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-07, the board of Fukuvi Chemical Industry resolved to acquire treasury stock under Company Law Article 156 (as applied via Article 165(3)). The company will purchase 650,000 shares (3.27% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) on 2026-08-10 at 08:45 JST via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥993 per share, the closing price of 2026-08-07. The maximum aggregate outlay is ¥715 million. The purchase order is valid only for that trading session; partial or zero acquisition is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be announced after trading closes. The stated rationale is to execute flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions, improve capital efficiency, and return value to shareholders.
